figures.claim: 1. Figure 1: Training and validation loss curves for different datasets. Each line represents a different run configuration, including the baseline and various attention re-routing mechanisms with different weighting factors. The shaded regions represent the standard error of the mean loss.
figures.explanation: Execution stage: Execution of the training script produced all_results.npy confirming the per-iteration loss curves. plot.py generates training and validation loss curves (separate plots per dataset) with one labeled line per run configuration (Baseline + Attention Re-routing weighting factors 0.9, 0.8, 0.7, 0.6) and shaded regions computed as standard error of the mean (fill_between at ±sterr). This exactly matches the claim description of Figure 1.
